comment: Kernset: was listPlugins Agenten standardmäßig zeigt (core: true). format = bevorzugtes Format, wenn es mehrere gibt (VST3 zeigt Einheiten, LV2 oft nur Zahlen). category und purpose stehen in listPlugins und pluginInfo.

plugins.name: 4OSC
plugins.purpose: simple 4-oscillator subtractive synth — set Wave/Filter Type/effects first (all off by default)

plugins.name: Sampler
plugins.purpose: plays your own samples on keys or key ranges (setSamples)

plugins.name: Drum Kit
plugins.purpose: sampler with dawd's basic kit in GM layout (36 kick, 38 snare, 42 hihat); swap samples with setSamples

plugins.name: Reverb
plugins.purpose: basic reverb

plugins.name: Delay
plugins.purpose: basic delay

plugins.name: Chorus
plugins.purpose: basic chorus

plugins.name: Compressor
plugins.purpose: basic compressor

plugins.name: Limiter
plugins.purpose: true-peak limiter for the master (Gain, Ceiling, Release)

plugins.name: Equaliser
plugins.purpose: 4-band EQ (shelves + 2 peaks)

plugins.name: Low Pass
plugins.purpose: low-pass / high-pass filter

plugins.name: Pitch Shifter
plugins.purpose: pitch shift in semitones

plugins.name: Surge XT
plugins.purpose: versatile hybrid synth (subtractive, wavetable, FM) with ~3000 categorised presets — start from listPresets

plugins.name: Diva
plugins.purpose: u-he analog-modelled poly synth (warm basses, pads, leads) with categorised .h2p presets

plugins.name: Dexed
plugins.purpose: DX7 FM synth: electric pianos, bells, FM basses, plucks — 32 programs per cartridge

plugins.name: MDA ePiano
plugins.purpose: Rhodes-like electric piano, few parameters, 5 presets

plugins.name: MDA Piano
plugins.purpose: simple acoustic piano

plugins.name: MDA JX10
plugins.purpose: simple analog-style poly synth with presets

plugins.name: Helm
plugins.purpose: free subtractive poly synth (2 osc + sub, filter, 3 LFOs, step sequencer, effects) with ~270 presets — basses, leads, pads, arps

plugins.name: Black Pearl Drumkit
plugins.purpose: acoustic rock/pop drum kit (AVL), GM layout

plugins.name: Red Zeppelin Drumkit
plugins.purpose: acoustic vintage rock drum kit (AVL), GM layout

plugins.name: Blonde Bop Drumkit
plugins.purpose: acoustic jazz drum kit (AVL), GM layout

plugins.name: Buskman's Holiday Percussion
plugins.purpose: hand percussion (AVL)

plugins.name: sfizz
plugins.purpose: SFZ sampler for multisampled instruments — listPresets shows the .sfz instruments in ~/sfz (Salamander Grand Piano installed)

plugins.name: Surge XT Effects
plugins.purpose: Surge's effect units as one plugin: reverbs, delays, chorus, EQ, distortion / overdrive / waveshaper (drive, amp-like crunch), tape saturation, Mid-Side Tool (stereo width, M/S), Airwindows Cabs (amp cabinets; FX Type Airwindows)

plugins.name: Dragonfly Hall Reverb
plugins.purpose: natural hall reverb (Size, Decay, Predelay, Early/Late Level, Dry Level 2)

plugins.name: Dragonfly Room Reverb
plugins.purpose: small to medium room reverb

plugins.name: Dragonfly Plate Reverb
plugins.purpose: plate reverb for vocals, snares

plugins.name: Dragonfly Early Reflections
plugins.purpose: early reflections only — space without a tail

plugins.name: LSP Parametric Equalizer x8 Stereo
plugins.purpose: precise 8-band parametric EQ

plugins.name: LSP Compressor Stereo
plugins.purpose: full-featured compressor (bus, drums, glue)

plugins.name: LSP Sidechain Compressor Stereo
plugins.purpose: compressor keyed from another signal (pumping, ducking)

plugins.name: LSP Multiband Compressor Stereo x8
plugins.purpose: multiband compressor for master or bus

plugins.name: LSP Gate Stereo
plugins.purpose: noise gate / transient shaping

plugins.name: LSP Limiter Stereo
plugins.purpose: transparent brickwall limiter

plugins.name: x42-eq - Parametric Equalizer Stereo
plugins.purpose: simple, clean parametric EQ (fil4)

plugins.name: x42-comp - Dynamic Compressor Stereo
plugins.purpose: simple compressor with few controls

plugins.name: x42-dpl - Digital Peak Limiter Stereo
plugins.purpose: simple peak limiter

plugins.name: MDA Ambience
plugins.purpose: small ambience / room

plugins.name: MDA DubDelay
plugins.purpose: dub-style feedback delay

plugins.name: MDA Overdrive
plugins.purpose: soft overdrive / saturation — warm drive, grit and crunch like a driven amp (drive, muffle, output)

plugins.name: MDA Bandisto
plugins.purpose: multiband distortion — drive per band (low/mid/high), crunchy amp-like grit, tube or transistor character

plugins.name: MDA Transient
plugins.purpose: transient shaper — harder or softer hits (attack/release emphasis), punch for chords, plucks and drums

plugins.name: LSP Clipper Stereo
plugins.purpose: clipper — hard/soft clipping of peaks, adds edge and density (drive); on by default: 'Enable input LUFS limitation' (threshold -3) and 'Overdrive protection' (threshold -1.5) — switch them off for plain clipping

plugins.name: MDA Image
plugins.purpose: stereo widener and M/S — S Width sets the side level (0.5 = mono, 0.75 = unchanged, 1 = wider), M Level the centre the same way, S Pan, M Pan; dawd starts Mode at 0.75 (left/right) — the plugin default 0.0 treats left/right as side/mid

plugins.name: Stereo Balance Control
plugins.purpose: x42 utility: polarity (phase invert left/right), L/R balance, trim, delay per channel in samples (Haas delay), channel swap or mono downmix

plugins.name: MDA Combo
plugins.purpose: amp and speaker cabinet simulator — Model (D.I., speaker, radio, small combo, large stack), Drive, Bias, high-pass; mono unless Stereo is on
